rationale.overall: Geometry and palette match so closely that the decisive gap is B’s closer continuous-tone ground lighting versus the REFERENCE, giving B the slight overall edge.
rationale.material: B’s lower light plane reads as a soft lit gradient like the REFERENCE, while A’s same plane keeps a fine hatch that flattens the material read; both still fall short of the REFERENCE’s cast shadow, grain, and ribbon translucency.
rationale.silhouette: Both takes share the same diagonal block, ribbon loop, plane split, and orange underglow, with no meaningful outline or negative-space difference.
rationale.smallsize: At 128, 32, and 16px the strips are effectively identical—dark bar plus orange underglow hold, and the ribbon collapses to the same grey smudge at 16px.
